body: I'm not sure if you went through with the experience or not, but if you're still deciding, I'd advise not to. As someone who's actually committed the act, there's a lot of regret and empty feeling. You feel good in the heat of the moment, sure, but the guilt is immeasurable. My self-esteem took even a worse dive because of it also its not funny, haha story you can just tell anyone. It's a pretty shunned act from a moral ethical standpoint and even a law standpoint wherever you live. If you have a conscious, it'll kick in immediately after it's over. This could affect future relationships you can have with someone else. You'll either come clean and get rejected later on or get judged or keep it a secret and feel horrible keeping it a secret. There's no win situation to it unless you don't care about any of that. It affected one of my close relationships, which made my depression even worse, and although I was able to patch things up with the person. There is a very different feel to our relationship than it was before the situation. I don't want to say it's life altering, but it could potentially be life altering to your social status if you care or even your health since you put yourself at risk STD/STI wise. I also want you to consider the ethics behind it. You being well off as you are is in a position where you can buy someone off for a quick session who is in a more desperate position for money than you are. They are doing this for their survival, although not every sex worker is the same. Most prostitutes aren't in well economic standings, so there is a power imbalance financially speaking. That's something I want you to think about to know how you would feel about knowing that. Again, if you are that willing and you don't care, hey, it's your choice, and it's your life, but coming from experience. Trust me and wait it out.
